summary: Macro Bank Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary, Banco Macro S.A., received authorization from the Central Bank of Argentina's Superintendencia to distribute profits of AR$138,956,468,470 (constant as of Dec 2025), payable in 3 monthly, equal, non-cumulative installments per Communication A 8410. The dividend expressed in constant currency as of Feb 2026 is AR$147,101,261,954. This is a return of capital to shareholders via a cash distribution. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for currency devaluation risk and timely Argentine regulatory payments.
